description: This source file defines data models for video items and curated demo video lists for a Flutter or Dart-based application. It includes classes for individual video items with metadata and a static list of sample videos.

classes.name: VideoItem
classes.description: Model representing a playable video source with metadata such as title, asset path, network URL, and poster.

classes.name: DemoVideos
classes.description: A class containing static predefined instances of VideoItem for sample demonstration videos.

methods.name: VideoItem.isNetwork
methods.description: Getter that indicates whether the video source is a network URL.

methods.name: VideoItem.toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method to provide a string representation of the video item.
